Class HLA13ReflectedAttributes

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.portico.impl.hla13.types.HLA13ReflectedAttributes
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    hla.rti.ReflectedAttributes

    public class HLA13ReflectedAttributes
extends Object

    This class just wraps a HLA13ByteArrayMap and passes all the relevant calls on to it.
